items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: when Nick Lucas, Nick Lucas come after making an appearance, yeah, at the shows

ctx.x: Well back to your parents, did your father and your relatives over there in the back each of the, did they all play fingerstyle?

Oh, yeah. Oh, no, no, no, no picking style in that time. Picking, really, Picking coming out in style and up until, well, when Nick Lucas, Nick Lucas come after making an appearance, yeah, at the shows, you know. Then he the one, first boy, picks picking down, yeah. Most fellas pick with the finger, they never use no picks to pick no get-up. No black picks. No, no, no, no, no, no kind. They didn't have no, what? Didn't have no picks. See? The fingerstyle, that was the only style that was known. Madelins, and,…
What about the Silver Leaf band? I ain't mentioned that.
